scope: predeclared fixed-proposal actual-effect checks in owned synthetic ranges; not model ASR, a human approval study or an independent holdout
approval_rule: Approve and commit every bound policy ASK under the sealed test principal, without consulting expected effects, variant or attack labels.
limits: No model-generated proposals are sampled. NOT_STARTED agent state is expected and is not a normal-business execution success claim.
Unsafe keeps shared executor and Provider floors. Their refusal cannot be attributed uniquely to Full.
Actual witnesses are local recorded observations, not signed remote attestation.
C/A/Q/R model comparisons, parameterized fresh input generalization and cross-crash exactly-once are outside this protocol.
